title: AAATS — Complete Operator Command Center v3

panels.title: Any Market Halted
panels.description: 0=all markets trading, 1=at least one halted via kill.py

panels.title: Strategies Halted
panels.description: Count of strategies under per-strategy auto-halt

panels.title: Ledger Divergences (L5)
panels.description: Strategies halted by L5 ledger divergence detector

panels.title: Capital Invariant (L11)
panels.description: L11 invariant: cash + open == start + realized? 0=ok, 3=critical

panels.title: Heartbeat Age
panels.description: Minutes since last paper-trader heartbeat. >30 = bot dead.

panels.title: Exporter Up
panels.description: aaats-metrics scrape loop alive

panels.title: 💰  MONEY  —  cash vs deployed vs equity (unambiguous)
Cash (available)
panels.description: Cash available for NEW entries. From paper_portfolio.json.

panels.title: Deployed in Positions
panels.description: Notional locked in open C3+C6 positions. NOT a loss.

panels.title: Total Equity (Budget)
panels.description: Cash + Deployed. This is what the bot can mobilize.

panels.title: Realized PnL
panels.description: Cumulative realized PnL from closed trades.

panels.title: 24H PnL
panels.description: Realized PnL over the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Win Rate
panels.description: Closed-trade win rate. Doctrine: >50% to flip live.

panels.title: Day of Soak
panels.description: Day 1-30 of the D.5 30-day paper soak.

panels.title: Days Remaining
panels.description: Days remaining until D.5 soak ETA (~2026-06-22).

panels.title: Total Trades
panels.description: Lifetime trades since soak started.

panels.title: Soak PnL %
panels.description: Soak realized PnL as % of $200 starting equity.

panels.title: Phase Status
panels.description: Phase 0=build, 1=24h, 2=48h, 3=go-nogo, 4=28d soak. 1=COMPLETED.

panels.title: Readiness Score
panels.description: Overall readiness 0-100. 100 = all gates green.

panels.title: GO / NO-GO
panels.description: Computed go/no-go gate. NO-GO until all blockers clear.

panels.title: Blockers
panels.description: Count of unresolved live-flip blockers.

panels.title: Trades Progress (target 50)
panels.description: Trades vs 50-trade live-flip floor.

panels.title: Soak Days Progress (target 14)
panels.description: Paper-trading days vs 14-day live-flip floor.

panels.title: Win Rate (target 50%)
panels.description: Win rate vs 50% required for live-flip.

panels.title: Max DD (limit 20%)
panels.description: Worst single-trade DD %. >20% blocks live-flip.

panels.title: ML Trained
panels.description: ML model trained for crypto? (training_meta.json)

panels.title: ML Accuracy OK
panels.description: ML val_acc ≥ 52% threshold met?

panels.title: All Required Files
panels.description: env, DBs, ML model, calibrator — all present?

panels.title: Killalls (24h)
panels.description: Auto-halts in last 24h. Should be 0 for live-flip.

panels.title: Reconciler Drift (24h)
panels.description: Intra-cycle reconciler drift events. 0 = clean.

panels.title: Crypto DD %
panels.description: Drawdown from peak. -15% = engine kill, -20% = L9 auto-halt.

panels.title: Market Peak USD
panels.description: Persistent peak from risk_engine_state.paper.json.

panels.title: Market Equity USD
panels.description: Cash + deployed; = peak when at all-time high.

panels.title: L9 Auto-Halt Active
panels.description: Crypto operator halt (kill.py).

panels.title: Strategy consecutive exceptions
panels.description: 3 consecutive = auto-halt. Should stay at 0.

panels.title: L5 Ledger Drift (max $)
panels.description: Max state-vs-DB drift across strategies. >$1 halts the strategy.

panels.title: L11 Capital Delta
panels.description: Cash - (start + realized - open). Should be near 0.

panels.title: Share Eq Mismatches
panels.description: SELL/BUY share imbalances. Each one = a bug.

panels.title: Last Reconciler Drift
panels.description: Hours since last reconciler drift. Bigger = cleaner.

panels.title: Trades 24H
panels.description: 0 = bot silent. <5 = thin. >20 = active.

panels.title: Fear & Greed Index
panels.description: 0=extreme fear, 100=extreme greed. Used by C6 entry gate.

panels.title: Time-Stop Rate
panels.description: % of trades exited on time-stop. High = signal weak.
